description: One Estonian company or other registered entity by its registry code or exact current name, from Estonia's e-Business Register (published as open data by RIK, the Estonian Centre of Registers and Information Systems). Returns identity (name, legal form, VAT number), registration status (registered/in liquidation/bankrupt), address, and currently reported EMTAK/NACE activity areas. Use for "what is the status of registry code 12417834" or "look up Bolt Technology OÜ". A company's CURRENT registered name is matched exactly -- a FORMER name (e.g. a company later renamed) will not match by name; look it up by registry code instead if known. For partial name matches use ee_company_search first.

name.description: Exact current registered name, e.g. "Bolt Technology OÜ". Case/diacritic-insensitive (works with or without õ/ä/ö/ü). Use ee_company_search for partial names.

name: ee_company
